sceneDescription: On a bright white office desk, a line of relay batons made from unexpected retail objects snakes left to right: a TikTok-branded makeup palette (subtle logo), a large Ulta-branded hairbrush, a Sally Beauty nail polish bottle, a tiny cardboard Amazon shipping box with a Prime tape, and an old-fashioned gold pocket watch (standing in for 'lost heirloom', but NOT a diamond). Each baton/object has a runner's hand just out of frame, as if they've just been handed off in a relay. Scattered in the background: a single running shoe, a Modern Retail magazine peeking from a tote, and a small Instore Magazine sticker on the pocket watch. The absurdity is in the retail-themed objects staged as a relay race, visually representing brands 'passing the baton' as commerce events shift. The lighting is flat, bright, and neutral, with everything in sharp focus and natural shadow from overcast daylight.
